children.value: > Fact From Story: “They’re overdoing it a little bit, for sure,” Kelce agreed.
> > Fact From Story: “I think everybody is just, like, overwhelmed,” the Chiefs tight end replied.

> > Fact From Story: In the New Heights podcase episode, titled “The NFL Needs to Calm Down”, Jason asked his brother plainly whether he thought the football was “overdoing it” with the coverage of Swift during the game.

> > > Fact From Story: Not only did the football league promote last Sunday’s game by speculating whether the Grammy winner will attend the Chiefs-Jets match, but cameras were constantly panning to the star-studded suite.
> > > Fact From Story: “I think everybody is just, like, overwhelmed,” the Chiefs tight end replied.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Excessive promotion and camera focus can lead to feelings of being overwhelmed.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone agrees that something is "overdoing it," they likely feel it's excessive and overwhelming.
> Fact From Story: Travis Kelce believes the National Football League’s coverage of his rumoured girlfriend Taylor Swift is a bit too much.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When someone says something is "a bit too much" or "overdoing it," they are admitting that it is excessive.
